svg.title: Six words from Week 6, drawn
svg.desc: Six labelled tiles. Imputation: a column reading 12, 29, blank, 41 becoming 12, 29, 29.5, 41, with the note that 29.5 is the median of the TRAIN rows. Missing indicator: two columns in and three out, with a pink 1 in the third column marking the row that was blank, and the note that it goes on the end. Data leakage: the answer reaching the model along a dashed red arrow, a value you will not have at the moment you must predict. Target leakage: the crosstab 1413, 35 on the top row and 12, 540 on the bottom, with 552 calls, 540 of them late, and 540 divided by 552 equals 0.9783. Temporal leakage: two strips of fifteen weeks, one with test blocks interleaved scoring 0.8139 and one cut at the end scoring 0.5249, and 0.8139 minus 0.5249 equals 0.2890. Preprocessing leakage: a red 0.765 above a green 0.520, and 0.765 minus 0.520 equals 0.245 of pure invention.
svg.text: it goes ON THE END, not beside
a value you will not have at
it ALWAYS pushes the score up
invented, on a table of noise
